source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP CEMSlot 1~2 should get pass result.

original_test_intent: Independently exercise the mapped temperature channel for each populated CEM Slot 1 and Slot 2 through approved warning and critical thresholds, verify correct SDR/SEL and platform protection behavior, then prove both slots, endpoints and host recover.
original_method: An attended engineer changes temperature, workload or approved airflow conditions for each physical CEM slot while IPMI sensor and SEL data are observed; the source does not define whether each reading is slot-air, riser or endpoint temperature.
manual_activity: An engineer maps Slot 1 and Slot 2 to their physical connectors, sensors and installed endpoints, chooses a device-appropriate bounded stimulus, operates it with abort authority, and owns recovery. Automation may monitor the declared per-slot matrix.
required_inputs: CEM definition plus physical slot, riser, sensor, PCIe BDF and installed endpoint identity for Slot 1 and Slot 2
per-slot applicability when empty and distinction among inlet, board, riser and endpoint-die temperature
units, accuracy, normal range, warning/critical thresholds, tolerance and hysteresis
endpoint-qualified load, chamber or local fixture with ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
per-slot SEL event data and expected fan, power, throttling, link, device-disable or host response
independent probes, endpoint-native telemetry, PCIe/driver logs, SEL retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not heat or obstruct an unidentified slot, or apply a generic workload to an unknown GPU, NIC or storage endpoint.

Monitor both target and adjacent-slot temperatures, PCIe link/AER, endpoint-native health, power, fans, BMC and host continuously; abort on overshoot, device error, link loss, power anomaly or instability.
Preserve the first endpoint, driver, AER, BMC and SEL failure evidence; do not clear it or automatically retry.
Use approved authenticated access instead of DeepSeek's password exposure and host-key bypass.
Restore airflow and workload, cool both slots, and verify every endpoint, link, fan and host path before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, poll the exact Slot 1 and Slot 2 SDRs, independent probes, endpoint-native telemetry, PCIe link/AER, device/driver health, power, fans, SEL and console state.
Correlate each threshold crossing and event to the correct physical slot and endpoint; do not let one slot or an adjacent sensor satisfy both-slot criteria.
Measure cross-coupling into the neighboring CEM slot and verify separate cooldown, deassertion and recovery.
Do not apply heat or load, change thresholds, clear logs, reset endpoints or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the slot/sensor/endpoint and applicability matrix, safe per-device stimulus, response criteria and recovery plan.
Operate the fixture or workload with physical oversight and abort authority.
Resolve device-specific anomalies and issue the final DUT verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor lists are baseline-only: they cannot create a per-slot transition, inspect SEL, distinguish slot-air from endpoint temperature, or prove endpoint/link recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted IPMI/SEL collection synchronized with per-slot independent probes, endpoint-native telemetry, PCIe AER/link and power/fan/host monitoring under an engineer-controlled stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original command, CEM Slot 1~2 target, heat-above-threshold requirement, script and 5/10-minute values remain preserved; the Project plan controls actual timing and device-specific method.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each physical slot and endpoint, baseline both slots and adjacent thermals, apply one bounded per-slot condition at a time, correlate sensor/SEL/device responses, then restore and prove endpoint and host recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, riser, slot population, endpoint type and airflow topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/riser, BMC/SDR, BIOS, endpoint firmware/driver, fixture and probe versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor chassis/riser/endpoint thermal limits, SDR/SEL mapping and PCIe/device recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous physical-slot and endpoint identity, adjacent-slot coupling, endpoint-native and PCIe health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable BMC sensor or one slot's event cannot prove both CEM slots, their endpoints or their recovery.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Slot/population map, device limits, event/protection matrix and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CEM slots may host different device classes; the same workload or thermal fixture is not automatically safe or equivalent across them.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may mark an unpopulated or unsupported slot not applicable only with the actual topology and approved rationale, and may select device-specific workload or fixture methods; it must record coverage per slot, uncovered behavior and equivalence limits.
expected_evidence: chassis/riser identity and Slot 1/2 physical connector, sensor, PCIe BDF and endpoint map
per-slot population/applicability, thresholds, event and response matrix
approved stimulus plus calibrated probe and abort record
timestamped per-slot BMC and endpoint temperatures, PCIe link/AER, driver/device, power, fan and host state
decoded warning/critical SEL assert/deassert records separately attributed to both slots
restored airflow/workload, per-slot cooldown/deassertion, endpoint/link/host/BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Code Wistron-BMC-00065-V003 is reused at row 1497 for an unrelated Web UI Sensor case. Row 775 remains the CEM thermal variant by physical identity; CEM terminology and slot topology are Project readiness inputs rather than justification to merge the rows.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The required function—exercise and verify both CEM slot thermal channels—is identifiable. Exact sensor/endpoint mapping, populated applicability, limits and safe device-specific stimulus are supplyable Project inputs. Attended setup plus synchronized monitoring is therefore conditional, not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES/no-risk to attended conditional execution and rejects static sensor lists as functional proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while retaining endpoint and host safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently strengthens the archived draft with slot-air-versus-endpoint distinction, adjacent-slot coupling and PCIe AER/link evidence.

review_improvement: Makes coverage independently accountable for both CEM slots and their actual endpoints, including cross-coupling and PCIe recovery, instead of treating two sensor names as sufficient.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Master intent is functional and per-slot, so a read-only inventory is partial evidence only. CEM slots can contain thermally and operationally different endpoints; Project topology and limits can resolve that normal variability without changing the test objective. Physical stimulus remains engineer-controlled while multi-source monitoring can be automated.
